title: A Change of Plans
transcript:
Good afternoon. This is a message for everyone coming to the community film night this Friday. We have been watching the weather all week. The wind should die down by Friday evening, but the latest report says heavy rain will arrive just before the film is due to begin. We have therefore decided to move the event indoors. The film will still start at seven, so there is no need to change your travel plans.

Please go to the main hall in the community centre. It is across the road from the garden where we usually hold film nights. The hall entrance faces the bus stop, and there is a small car park behind the building. If you arrive by bike, you can leave it in the covered space next to the main doors.

You can still use the ticket you booked online. Show it on your phone or bring a printed copy. If you are bringing children, make sure you have each child's ticket as well as your own. We have enough seats for everyone who booked.

The doors open at half past six. Volunteers wearing yellow badges will help you find a seat. After the film, the café will stay open until ten. This will give people who normally walk home through the garden a dry place to wait if they are being picked up.

questions.prompt: Why did the organizers change their plans?
questions.explanation: 天气预报说会下雨，所以放映改到室内。

questions.prompt: Where will the film be shown?
options: In the main hall at the community centre.
In the café behind the bus stop.
questions.answer: In the main hall at the community centre.
questions.explanation: 放映地点改为社区中心的主厅。

questions.prompt: What should people do if they already booked online?
options: Exchange the ticket at the entrance.
questions.explanation: 原来在网上订的票仍然有效。
戴黄色徽章的志愿者会帮助观众找座位。
